items.title: Oscars Will 'Always' Reward Human Excellence in AI Era, Academy Chiefs Say
items.excerpt: Academy president Lynette Howell Taylor tells Variety in Tokyo that the Oscars will keep honoring human-driven work as AI spreads through filmmaking, while leadership leaves the door open to tweaking international feature rules.

items.title: Ancestral Memory Meets AI in Himalayan Drama 'Shirjara: Song of Grandmother' at Tokyo Gap-Financing Market
items.excerpt: Bikash Subedi's Nepali feature sets a grandmother's oral stories against the rise of artificial intelligence; the film has wrapped principal photography and is seeking gap financing at TIFFCOM with an eye on a Cannes premiere.

items.title: Singapore Media Festival Launches Creator Summit as Asia TV Forum Adds AI Zone, Microdrama Focus
items.excerpt: ATF adds 'The AI Era | Entertainment Reimagined' strand and zone on AI in content creation, IP rights and regulation, plus the final round of AI Hackathon 2026 with a live creative contest and screenings.

items.title: Google's next Genie AI model generates more realistic experiences
items.excerpt: Google DeepMind's Genie 4 world model generates more realistic, interactive AI worlds from prompts in real time. Note: DeepMind's own Genie 4 post already ran in the games section on 10-28.

items.title: Apple Creator Studio update: MotionVFX and AI
items.excerpt: Apple Creator Studio's free November update builds MotionVFX into Final Cut Pro and adds AI assistants to Logic Pro, Keynote, Pages and Numbers. Note: Engadget's version of this story ran in the music section on 10-28.

items.title: Rintaro On Anime's Aversion To Risk: 'There Will Be No Future'
items.excerpt: At Busan, the 'Galaxy Express 999' and 'Metropolis' director ties anime's remake culture to generative AI, arguing AI 'recommends the mean or the average' and pushes toward remaking past works instead of creating something new.

items.title: Hollywood Animation Directors On Distribution, Sequels, And AI
items.excerpt: At View Conference, the directors of 'GOAT', 'Forgotten Island' and 'Toy Story 5' discussed box office and original storytelling; questions on generative AI met a notably cool reception from the panel.

items.title: The Final Boss of Green Screen. (CorridorKey 2.0 launch)
items.excerpt: Corridor Digital releases CorridorKey 2.0, its neural green/blue-screen keyer that runs locally as a one-click plugin for Resolve, Nuke, After Effects, Premiere and Blender, with a free GitHub version too. Beta pricing runs until Nov 20.

items.title: New Mystery AI Video Model: Iron Goddess!
items.excerpt: An unclaimed video model called 'Iron Goddess' appeared in battle mode on the Arena, showing big, fast motion that smudges frame-by-frame. Compared against Seedance 2.5, with speculation it is Alibaba's model due in November.

items.title: Is Kling 4 Better Than Seedance 2.5 for AI Films?
items.excerpt: A filmmaker starting a new AI short tests Kling 4 against Seedance 2.5 on directing dramatic performances, keyframe control of complex scenes, water physics, and character swaps with camera motion.

items.title: ByteDance launches Seedance 2.5 4K video model for film production
items.excerpt: Volcano Engine's Seedance 2.5 4K targets film and TV production with 10-bit color, better facial expressions and fine detail, and a 480p Draft mode for testing shots and storyboards before final 4K renders. It is in trials with selected enterprise customers. (Off-list source: no allowed outlet covered it.)

items.title: ByteDance launches AI studio for short-drama production
items.excerpt: ByteDance's Jimeng AI launched a short-drama studio that puts script development, character and scene creation, storyboarding, video production and post into one workflow, using its in-house DreamScript, Anycook and DreamShot models. (Off-list source.)
